posts.title: Blood Physiology for UPSC CMS: RBC, WBC, Platelets and Coagulation
posts.description: Blood physiology for UPSC CMS — RBC lifecycle, haemoglobin function, WBC types and functions, platelet role, and the coagulation cascade.
posts.excerpt: Blood physiology for UPSC CMS — RBC indices, WBC differentials, platelet function, and the coagulation cascade with intrinsic/extrinsic pathways.
posts.author: CrackCMS Editorial Team
posts.body: RBC: 120 days lifespan, spleen removes senescent cells. Hb structure: 2 alpha + 2 beta chains, heme with iron. WBC: neutrophils (55-70%), lymphocytes (20-40%), monocytes (2-8%), eosinophils (1-4%), basophils (<1%). Coagulation: intrinsic (XII-XI-IX-VIII), extrinsic (VII-tissue factor). Both converge at X.
